steps.name: Given an INFLUENCER user "reconsent-influencer@lifecycle.test" with consents not accepted
And a session exists for "reconsent-influencer@lifecycle.test" as INFLUENCER
When the user sends POST to "/applied-opportunity" with empty body
Then the response status should be 403

expected 403; response body: {"timestamp":"2026-10-22T07:18:07.165943854","status":403,"error":"Forbidden","message":"You must accept the updated terms to continue using the platform","path":"/api/applied-opportunity","code":"error.auth.consent_required","requestId":"REQ-58056406"}
And the response should have header "X-Consent-Required"
headers: vary, x-request-id, x-consent-required, x-content-type-options, x-xss-protection, cache-control, pragma, expires, x-frame-options, content-type, content-length, date, keep-alive, connection
When the user records consent for all required documents
And the user "reconsent-influencer@lifecycle.test" refreshes their mock session as INFLUENCER
Then the response status should be 200

expected 200; response body: {"id":2531,"firebaseUserId":"E2EINFLUENCER1792653487112","userType":{"value":"INFLUENCER","label":"Influencer","originalLabel":"INFLUENCER"},"email":"reconsent-influencer@lifecycle.test","profilePicture":null,"addresses":[],"accountStatus":{"value":"ACTIVE","label":"Aktywne","description":"Konto jest aktywne i w pełni funkcjonalne","originalLabel":"ACTIVE","colorTheme":"success","icon":"user-check
And the response body field "accountStatus" should be "ACTIVE"
